raw_segments.text: Regan, I speak in understanding, yea I note, therefore I do advise you take this note.
My lord is dead, Edmund and I have talked, and more convenient is he for my hand than
If you do find him, pray you give him this, and when your mistress hears thus much from
you, I pray desire her call her wisdom to her.
If you do chance to hear of that blind traitor, preferment falls on him that cuts him off."
